Marta (prod): Quick thread to capture the "onramp" asks we've been getting re: routing + multi-tenant isolation. Need a pragmatic GA scope we can sell to customers.
Diego (infra): TL;DR proposal: GA covers deterministic regional affinity, capacity reservations for Dedicated, clear fallback semantics, and a customer-visible event stream for routing decisions.
Sana (architecture): Agree. Important to explicitly call out what well NOT promise in GA: no hard eviction guarantees, no per-tenant single-node pinning, and no automated cross-region live migration.
Ethan (eng): Impl note: a minimal policy DSL could look like:
```
policy {
  tenant: "acme"
  affinity: ["eu-west-1", "eu-north-1"]
  fallback: {family: "redwood-4x"}
  reservation: {type: "dedicated", burst: true}
}
```
That parser + decision service is the core engineering work.
Priya (sales): Customers asking for residency will expect: (1) spelled-out reside windows, (2) a handoff for Dedicated setup, (3) contract language for placement-level credits if violated.
Marta (prod): For launch criteria I propose:
- routing decisions explained in console and events (reason code)
- reservation API available and tested
- fallback policy documented with quality caveats
- runbook for tenant moves + comms template
Diego (infra): Ops acceptance: failure-mode test where a region is saturated and we verify 2 things: (a) fallback happens within 200ms decision latency, (b) customers get the notification within 5 minutes. We'll add a chaos test for that.
Sana (architecture): Risk list: fragmentation of capacity when many tenants reserve, model-compatibility causing silent quality drops, and telemetry volume explosion if we emit per-token route events.
Ethan (eng): Mitigations: autoscale reservations with burst credit pools, model-family compatibility scoring so fallback can be gated, and sampled telemetry with a debug mode for full fidelity.
routing-bot: RFC created: /rfc/onramp-affinity-207777  includes sample DSL, gating checklist, and load test plan. https://redwood.internal/rfc/onramp-affinity-207777
Priya (sales): Need a simple 1-paragraph customer facing statement for sales decks. Something like: "Redwood lets you lock region affinity for Dedicated deployments and provides transparent fallback behavior and notifications when capacity constraints require rerouting." Can legal review for GA phrasing?
Marta (prod): Action items:
- Sana: finalize DSL and short RFC (due 2077777888)
- Diego + Ethan: prototype reservation API + decision service and a chaos test (due 2077778200)
- Priya: draft contract language and 3 example customer scenarios (due 2077778000)
- Marta: write launch criteria doc + comms templates (due 2077778050)
Priya (sales): I'll also compile the customer list that has asked for strict residency.
Diego (infra): One more ask: make telemetry include a single route_reason field with enumerated values (AFFINITY, RESERVATION, FALLBACK, CAPACITY). Easier for SLO dashboards.
Marta (prod): Perfect. We'll kick off a 30-min cross-functional sync once the RFC is up. Keep quick updates here. :rocket:
